name: 10-Meter Walk Test
description: Patient walks 10 meters at comfortable pace; gait speed calculated in m/s. Higher is better.
shirleySays: ICC 0.95–0.99. MDC: 0.13–0.18 m/s. MCID: 0.10–0.16 m/s (general). Normative mean ~1.4 m/s (healthy adults 20–60 yr). Strong predictor of functional outcomes, fall risk, and mortality. Validated in stroke, SCI, MS, PD, TBI, amputation, geriatrics.
